name: Vetala
description: A class of spirit-beings in Hindu mythology that inhabits and animates corpses, traditionally associated with cremation grounds, fortune-telling, and the riddle-cycle of Vikramaditya in the Vetala Panchavimshati.
origin: The vetala is a feature of Hindu mythology and South Asian folklore, with the strongest literary and cultic tradition in India and Nepal. Regional veneration of Vetoba/Betal is concentrated in the Konkan coastal region of western India.
